request: What are the top 5 product categories by revenue and how do their review scores and delivery times compare?
sub_questions: What are the top 5 product categories by total revenue, defined as the sum of order item prices?
What is the average review score for each of the top 5 product categories by total revenue?
What is the average delivery time in days from order purchase to customer delivery for each of the top 5 product categories by total revenue?

evidence.sub_question: What are the top 5 product categories by total revenue, defined as the sum of order item prices?
evidence.sql: SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
evidence.answer:
Top 5 product categories by total revenue (sum of order item prices):

1. health_beauty — 1,258,681.34
2. watches_gifts — 1,205,005.68
3. bed_bath_table — 1,036,988.68
4. sports_leisure — 988,048.97
5. computers_accessories — 911,954.32

These are the only categories shown in the returned rows; no other categories or totals are provided.

evidence.sub_question: What is the average review score for each of the top 5 product categories by total revenue?
evidence.sql:
WITH category_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name AS category_key,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
),
top_categories AS (
  SELECT category_key, category, total_revenue
  FROM category_revenue
  ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT tc.category,
       AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM top_categories tc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_name = tc.category_key
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY tc.category, tc.total_revenue
ORDER BY tc.total_revenue DESC
evidence.answer:
Based on the returned rows, the average review scores for the top 5 product categories by total revenue are:

| Category | Avg Review Score |
|---|---|
| health_beauty | 4.14 |
| sports_leisure | 4.11 |
| watches_gifts | 4.02 |
| computers_accessories | 3.93 |
| bed_bath_table | 3.90 |

health_beauty has the highest average review score (≈4.14), and bed_bath_table the lowest (≈3.90) among these five. All values are rounded from the returned averages; exact figures are in the query results.

evidence.sub_question: What is the average delivery time in days from order purchase to customer delivery for each of the top 5 product categories by total revenue?
evidence.sql:
WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
           SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    GROUP BY 1
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT category
    FROM category_revenue
    ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
delivery_stats AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
           AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) IN (SELECT category FROM top_categories)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ds.category, ds.avg_delivery_days
FROM delivery_stats ds
JOIN category_revenue cr ON cr.category = ds.category
ORDER BY cr.total_revenue DESC
evidence.answer:
Based on the returned rows, the average delivery time (order purchase to customer delivery) for the top 5 product categories by total revenue is:

| Category | Avg. Delivery (days) |
|---|---|
| health_beauty | 11.98 |
| watches_gifts | 12.66 |
| bed_bath_table | 12.81 |
| sports_leisure | 12.15 |
| computers_accessories | 13.23 |

The fastest among these is health_beauty (~11.98 days) and the slowest is computers_accessories (~13.23 days). All five categories fall in the ~12–13 day range. (Values rounded to two decimals from the returned rows.)
